newsitem.title: USA: Roberts Oil changes name, positions.
newsitem.headline: Roberts Oil changes name, positions.

text.p: Roberts Oil and Gas Inc said Thursday it changed its to Adair International Oil and Gas Inc as it had previously announced in June.
John Adair was named as chairman and and chief executive.
The company also said it named Earl Roberts, the former chairman and president, president and chief operating officer of Adair. He will serve on the company's board as well.
The changes were adopted at a special shareholders' meeting held earlier this week, the company said.

In June, Roberts had acquired a five percent stake in some of Adair's exploration acreage in exchange for Roberts common stock. As a result of that transaction, privately-owned Adair became the majority owner of Roberts.
